metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2004 · Garth Marenghi's Darkplace
metas.description: This parody series is an unearthed 80s horror/drama, complete with poor production values, awful dialogue and hilarious violence. The series is set in a Hospital in Romford, which is situated over the gates of Hell.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2001 · Hellsing
metas.description: A British taskforce, lead by the daughter of the vampire hunter Prof. Van Helsing, battles the supernatural with the aid of two vampires.

metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2005 · Mushi-Shi
metas.description: Mushi Master Ginko travels from place to place investigating occurrences that could be tied to supernatural creatures called Mushi.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2004 · Wonderfalls
metas.description: 24-year-old loner B.A. Jaye lives in a trailer park and sells souvenirs in Niagara Falls. Animal figurines and dolls speak to her and force her to interact with people and try to help them.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2007 · The Dresden Files
metas.description: Harry Dresden is a wizard, the only one listed in the Chicago phone book. He's got a handle on the crimes that can't be solved by anyone else. Paranormal? No problem. Dresden deals in all matters of supernatural threats.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2008 · Ashes to Ashes
metas.description: After being shot in 2008 while investigating DCI Sam Tyler, DI Alex Drake wakes up in 1981.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2008 · Eli Stone
metas.description: San Francisco lawyer Eli Stone begins to see things, which leads him to discover a brain aneurysm. But his visions lead him to accept cases with little monetary gain but a lot of moral goodness.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2006 · That Mitchell and Webb Look
metas.description: A comedy sketch show featuring David Mitchell and Robert Webb.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2007 · Journeyman
metas.description: A San Francisco journalist mysteriously travels to the past and alters the path of people's lives. When his travels reunite him with his long-lost fiancée Livia, life with his present-day wife gets very interesting.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2007 · Saving Grace
metas.description: An angel offers a jaded Oklahoma City police detective the chance to redeem her life.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2005 · The Master and Margarita
metas.description: The devil and his attendants visit Moscow at the times of the Stalin regime. Official atheistic ideology confronts with a series of supernatural events.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2002 · Haibane Renmei
metas.description: A young girl is reborn as an angel-like creature called a haibane, with no memory of who she once was.
